races.name: Southwell Cardinal Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Golden View
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with William Buick aboard, but the 127-day absence since his Newmarket win raises fitness questions despite Appleby's excellent record.

runners_data.name: Intense Vision
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced and unproven on this surface, though back-to-back wins suggest ability but 184 days off track creates uncertainty about current form.

runners_data.name: Yazin
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with highest RPR of 107 and Ryan Moore's tactical nous, though needs to overcome 174-day layoff against a soft pace scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Golden View sits as the only natural front-runner in this small field, with both Yazin and Intense Vision likely to track behind given their prominent tendencies. The pace will be entirely controlled by Golden View, who can dictate terms without pressure and set sustainable fractions throughout the mile trip. Yazin and Intense Vision will be content to sit in behind, creating a scenario where the leaders get an easy time of it. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as there's no speed pressure to compromise Golden View's position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Golden View Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Golden View gets easy lead fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The Charlie Appleby runner controls the tempo completely and has enough class edge to repel late challenges. William Buick can time his move perfectly from the front with no pace pressure throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Yazin Times Run Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Yazin can get first run on Golden View approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The Gosden runner's superior RPR of 107 tells as Ryan Moore produces him with a well-timed challenge. Golden View may find the 127-day break just tells against a race-fit opponent.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Intense Vision Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced runner has trained on significantly during his 184-day absence
scenarios.body: His back-to-back wins suggest untapped potential and the long break could have been purposeful. Jonny Peate gets a dream tow into the race behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If all three get into a war from the home turn with none able to finish strongly
scenarios.body: The combination of small field and lack of early pace creates a stop-start tempo that suits none. The winner emerges from a blanket finish with little between them.

watchPoints.text: Golden View's jumping and early positioning - if he doesn't lead cleanly, his whole race plan falls apart in this small field
Yazin's fitness levels after 174 days off - any signs of rustiness early will compromise Moore's tactical options
Intense Vision's adaptation to the surface - first run on this track type could reveal significant improvement or unsuitability
The pace through the first half-mile - if it goes too slowly, it neutralizes Golden View's main tactical advantage
Market moves on Intense Vision - any strong support would suggest the yard expects significant improvement from the break

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Blue Deveron
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader with solid recent form at the trip, though 28 days off track may have dulled his sharpness slightly.

runners_data.name: Believeinmenow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor trainer form recently but consistent at this level, headgear change could spark improvement.

runners_data.name: Life After Love
runners_data.note: Strong finisher with excellent course record but faces tactical difficulty in small field, Hollie Doyle booking notable.

runners_data.name: Beach Partee
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse with decent form but similarly compromised by pace scenario, headgear applied again.

runners_data.name: Sands Of Seve
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying bottom weight with solid trainer form, best placed to track and challenge the leader.

races.paceDynamic: Blue Deveron will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge him, giving James Tate's gelding an uncontested advantage in a small field. Believeinmenow and Sands Of Seve may track him prominently but neither are natural pace-pressers, while Life After Love and Beach Partee will settle last in the field of five. The sustainable gallop Blue Deveron sets will dictate the race, with the real battle coming from the prominent runners who can travel kindly behind him rather than the hold-up horses who face a tough task from the back in such a small field. This race shape strongly favours the leader and prominent runners who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Blue Deveron Stays Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Deveron gets an easy lead and kicks clear in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate throughout and find extra when challenged. His consistent form at the trip on similar going gives him every chance to complete the job from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Believeinmenow or Sands Of Seve can track the leader and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit horses who can stay in touch without over-racing, allowing them to strike when Blue Deveron tires. Sands Of Seve's low weight or Believeinmenow's class could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and Life After Love gets a perfect run from Hollie Doyle
scenarios.body: The small field opens up gaps for a strong finisher to exploit, with Life After Love's excellent form on this surface making her dangerous. Beach Partee could also benefit from similar tactics if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Deveron goes too slow and gets swamped by the entire field in a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs where class and finishing kick matter most. Any of the field could prevail in a blanket finish if the early pace is suicidal.

watchPoints.text: Blue Deveron breaks smartly and gets an easy lead - if uncontested early he becomes very difficult to peg back
Life After Love gets shuffled back too far in the small field where there may be limited room for late runs
Believeinmenow shows early speed to press Blue Deveron - could force a stronger pace that suits the closers
Sands Of Seve over-races in the prominent position and fails to see out the trip under bottom weight
Beach Partee finds a gap in the final furlong when others have already made their moves

races.name: Dog Friendly Raceday Tues 2nd June Handicap

runners_data.name: John Galt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent recent form but no wins in 5 starts, jockey Saffie Osborne provides 5lb claim advantage

runners_data.name: Swinging London
runners_data.note: Reliable hold-up performer with best recent RPR of 84, veteran campaigner who has won once on similar conditions

runners_data.name: The Truant
runners_data.note: Only natural pace horse giving him tactical control, but concerning drop in form with TS rating of just 47

runners_data.name: Vaguely Royal
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with Jamie Spencer's tactical expertise, but trainer Ian Williams struggling at 0/22 in past 14 days

runners_data.name: Captain Brett
runners_data.note: Long absence of 257 days creates uncertainty despite previous good form, needs to prove fitness first time back

races.paceDynamic: The Truant will take the field along from the front with no other natural pace horses to challenge him early. This sets up a controlled tempo that allows The Truant to dictate terms without being pressured through the early stages. With four hold-up horses (John Galt, Swinging London, Vaguely Royal, Captain Brett) all needing to be delivered late, they'll be reliant on The Truant providing enough pace to set up a finish. This race shape strongly favours The Truant's prominent style, as he can control the pace and has the tactical advantage over the hold-up brigade who must rely on his tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Truant Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If The Truant maintains a steady but honest gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter can dictate ideal fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from off the slow pace. The Truant's tactical advantage proves decisive against horses who need more pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If The Truant sets genuine fractions and weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace allows the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks with Swinging London and John Galt best positioned to capitalize. The pace collapse gives the closers their ideal scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If The Truant goes too slow early and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a muddling affair where positioning becomes crucial rather than finishing kick. Jamie Spencer's tactical nous on Vaguely Royal could prove the difference in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Captain Brett Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Brett shows no rust from his 257-day layoff and gets a perfect trip
scenarios.body: The long-absent horse benefits from the likely honest pace and his proven class on similar ground conditions shines through. His fresh legs could be an asset in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: The Truant's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if he goes too slow, the hold-up horses gain a significant advantage
Captain Brett's fitness after 257 days off - any signs of rustiness early will effectively eliminate him from contention
Jamie Spencer's positioning on Vaguely Royal through the middle stages - his tactical decisions could unlock the horse's chance
Swinging London's settling early given his hold-up style - needs to get a clear run when the pace lifts
John Galt's response to pressure - has been thereabouts recently but needs to find that extra gear to win

races.name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Marnier
runners_data.note: Natural leader with class edge but coming off a poor run, though Gosden stable and Havlin booking suggests confidence returning

runners_data.name: Lady Ridgewood
runners_data.note: Perfect prominent style for this pace shape, though 252 days off is a concern despite her course-and-distance win

runners_data.name: Desert Shadow
runners_data.note: Strong prominent runner but Bin Suroor's UK runners often need their first run back, plus no recent wins

runners_data.name: Yaa Min
runners_data.note: Improving sort with 7lb weight pull, claiming jockey reduces experience but recent Southwell win shows current form

runners_data.name: New York Minute
runners_data.note: Pure hold-up horse who needs strong pace to be effective, which seems unlikely here with one leader

runners_data.name: Elsass
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner returning from a long break, needs everything to fall right from the back

races.paceDynamic: Marnier will lead from the front uncontested, with Lady Ridgewood, Desert Shadow and Yaa Min settling just behind in the second rank. The pace will be comfortable early with no other natural leaders to pressure Marnier through the first mile. New York Minute and Elsass will track from the rear as hold-up horses. This sustainable tempo followed by a sprint finish clearly favours the prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the leader's workload.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate allowing trackers to pounce
scenarios.body: Lady Ridgewood and Desert Shadow get perfect trips tracking the uncontested leader before unleashing superior kicks. The comfortable gallop sets up ideally for horses with tactical speed from prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Marnier's class tells and the kick-back is minimal
scenarios.body: The Gosden-trained leader uses the soft lead to dictate terms and finds enough in the tank when challenged. His recent form shows he handles this exact scenario well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly creating a strong gallop
scenarios.body: New York Minute gets the fast pace his style craves and unleashes a devastating late run from the back. Elsass could also benefit if the leaders go too fast early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Yaa Min gets a perfect stalking trip on the inner
scenarios.body: The improving four-year-old exploits his low weight and recent Southwell win to strike from an ideal position. His form has been building nicely for this opportunity.

watchPoints.text: New York Minute and Elsass both need faster pace than Marnier alone is likely to provide from the front
Lady Ridgewood's 252-day absence could blunt her natural speed despite Spencer's booking
Marnier's early position will be crucial - if he's allowed to bowl along uncontested he becomes very dangerous
Desert Shadow's market position will reveal stable confidence after recent moderate efforts
Yaa Min's claimer Jack Callan may lack tactical awareness if the pace becomes stop-start

races.name: Come Racing For Free 18th June Handicap

runners_data.name: Clear Above
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with apprentice Ethan Tindall claiming 5lbs, but inconsistent recent form and poor strike rate concern in this competitive field.

runners_data.name: Aneirin's Sword
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned to track the leader, with Saffie Osborne's 2-from-7 recent wins for trainer Jamie Osborne showing stable in form.

runners_data.name: Lexington Express
runners_data.note: Front-runner with highest TS rating who should get uncontested lead, though 19 days since last run could blunt his finishing kick slightly.

runners_data.name: Action Reaction
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse claiming 3lbs through Jack Callan but three poor runs in a row and 0-from-3 record on similar going raises questions.

runners_data.name: Raspoutine
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with highest RPR rating fresh from 9-day break victory, representing in-form Sir Mark Prescott stable with strong recent record.

runners_data.name: Cobalt Comet
runners_data.note: Back-marker with useful TS rating of 58 but trainer John Mackie 0-from-7 in last 14 days and horse winless in three similar going attempts.

races.paceDynamic: Lexington Express will set the pace uncontested from the front, with Aneirin's Sword likely to track in second and provide the only potential early pressure. The moderate early tempo will allow the hold-up horses Clear Above, Action Reaction, Raspoutine and Cobalt Comet to get into comfortable positions before making their moves. With only one genuine front-runner and no speed battle expected, this sets up as a tactical affair that will develop late. This pace scenario strongly favours the prominent and hold-up horses who can benefit from the steady gallop and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lexington Express Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Express gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds a decisive advantage as the field struggles to reel him in up the straight. His superior TS rating of 60 and proven front-running ability make him hard to catch when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up quartet get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Raspoutine's class edge (RPR 79) and recent win form make him the most likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Aneirin's Sword Times Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Aneirin's Sword applies more pressure to Lexington Express throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first run on the leader and times his challenge perfectly as Lexington Express begins to tire. His consistent form and Saffie Osborne's tactical nous prove decisive in a two-horse battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Express stops quickly and Aneirin's Sword also fades from the pace battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the back with all four hold-up horses converging in the final furlong. Action Reaction and Cobalt Comet could outrun their odds if finding their best form simultaneously.

watchPoints.text: Lexington Express breaking slowly or getting hassled early by Aneirin's Sword would completely alter the pace complexion and favour the closers.
Raspoutine's jump from the stalls given his hold-up style - a slow start could leave him with too much ground to make up in a small field.
The gap between Lexington Express and Aneirin's Sword turning for home will determine if the leaders can hold off the closers.
Any of the four hold-up horses getting caught wide without cover would severely compromise their chances in the straight.
Clear Above and Action Reaction both carrying 3lb+ apprentice allowances could give them the edge if the finish becomes tight between the outsiders.

races.name: Conference & Events At Southwell Racecourse Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Got The Booty
runners_data.comment: Second at Southwell on return two weeks ago; sets the standard and should stay an easy 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of her three starts (all 6f), recording an RPR of 73 when second of six (front two clear) at Southwell 13 days ago; open to further progress and this easy 7f should be in range; sets the standard.

races.name: Ladies Day Sunday 16th August Handicap

runners_data.name: Enpassant
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form and proven course record, well-placed to benefit from expected strong pace

runners_data.name: Bomb Squad
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer with excellent course record and Hollie Doyle's 10lb claim, ideally suited to race shape

runners_data.name: Mereside Madness
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 40-day break with hat-trick headgear change, may need this run

runners_data.name: Searchingtheblues
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent course form but question marks over best trip being 6f rather than 7f

runners_data.name: Mwafaq
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up horse with hat-trick on his mind and 5lb claimer taking off valuable weight

runners_data.name: Berning Hot
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 78-day layoff, likely to need the run despite bottom weight

runners_data.name: On Key
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who gets first run on hold-up horses and benefits from 10lb weight drop

runners_data.name: Fools Rush In
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade in finish, making him vulnerable despite course form

runners_data.name: Adelaide Bay
runners_data.note: Non-runner

runners_data.name: Louie The Legend
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner whose low TopSpeed rating suggests stamina over speed

races.paceDynamic: Louie The Legend will take the field along at a sustainable pace from the front, with On Key likely to race prominently behind him. The lack of other confirmed pace-setters means the early tempo should be controlled rather than frantic. With eight of ten runners classified as hold-up horses, a wall of runners will be charging from the rear in the final two furlongs. This setup clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best work late, as they'll benefit from the honest pace and have plenty of room to manoeuvre in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Staying Kick Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The controlled early tempo will set up perfectly for the stronger finishers to unleash sustained challenges from the back. Hold-up horses with proven stamina at the trip will have every chance to showcase their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Louie The Legend and On Key build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure could allow the prominent pair to dictate terms and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can respond. Those racing handy will have first run on the field when the sprint begins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses causes interference in running
scenarios.body: With eight runners looking to come from behind, inevitable bunching and blocked runs will occur in the straight. The horses already positioned prominently will avoid the scramble and maintain clear passages to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Louie The Legend goes too slow and gets caught napping
scenarios.body: An overly pedestrian gallop could see the race become a sprint finish where pure speed trumps stamina. The fresher horses with recent good form will have the sharpness to capitalise on a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Louie The Legend sets the pace alone - if he goes too slowly early, he could get swamped by superior horses late
Traffic problems in the straight with eight hold-up horses all looking for room simultaneously
On Key's prominent position could prove crucial if the hold-up horses struggle to get clear runs
Mwafaq's 5lb claimer Ethan Tindall needs to judge the pace perfectly from his hold-up position
Bomb Squad's proven course specialist credentials make her dangerous despite wide draw implications

races.name: Summer Social Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Moostar
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner who should get easy lead but vulnerable if pace becomes truly testing late on

runners_data.name: Raft Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with Ethan Tindall's 5lb claim providing significant weight relief in competitive handicap

runners_data.name: Valsharah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form who can press leader or track and pounce, handles standard going well

runners_data.name: Blackjack
runners_data.note: Aging prominent runner whose best days may be behind him despite solid course record over this distance

runners_data.name: Fircombe Hall
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up horse with Hollie Doyle aboard, recent course winner who thrives when getting cover early

runners_data.name: Megaphone
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs strong pace to be effective, lowest TopSpeed rating suggests limited finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Moostar will take the field along from the front with no serious early pressure, setting a comfortable rhythm through the opening furlongs. The three prominent runners (Valsharah, Blackjack) will track close behind but none are confirmed speed balls who will hassle the leader early. This sets up a sustained gallop that should suit the three hold-up horses (Raft Up, Fircombe Hall, Megaphone) who can get cover and deliver late challenges. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Moostar sets pedestrian fractions unchallenged through halfway
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows closers to conserve energy and unleash devastating late runs in the final furlong. Fircombe Hall and Raft Up can time their challenges perfectly when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Valsharah or Blackjack apply earlier pressure to Moostar from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field but still allows the best-positioned prominent runner to kick clear. Valsharah's recent form edge gives her the tactical advantage over the aging Blackjack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Moostar maintains a strong gallop and none of the closers produce their kick
scenarios.body: The leader's uncontested early advantage proves decisive when the pursuers fail to reel him in. His recent second at this trip suggests he can handle the sustained pace pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly crawling with multiple horses still in contention turning in
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes a lottery where any horse can win from any position. The jockey with the best judgement of when to commit will prevail in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Moostar to go too fast early if any of the prominent runners pressure him from the 4f pole
Monitor Fircombe Hall's position turning in as she needs clear room to deliver her finishing kick effectively
Observe if Valsharah can secure the ideal stalking position just behind the leader without getting trapped
Check if Raft Up can overcome the outside draw to get the cover she needs for her hold-up style
Note whether the pace is genuinely strong enough to set up Megaphone's limited finishing kick
